text: This solution, Nepal Insurance Authority (NIA) addresses natural catastrophe through public private partnerships in Nepal between Government of Nepal, Nepal Rastra Bank, Nepal Insurance Authority, International Association of Insurance Supervisors, Insurers, Reinsurers, Intermediaries (brokers, agents, surveyors), and Industry associations. The program was implemented in 2022 and focuses on regulation, collaboration, and raising awareness.
